about: Kabra Extrusiontechnik Limited was incorporated in 1982. It is part of the Kolsite group and operates in the business of plastic extrusion machinery. KET specializes in providing plastic extrusion machinery for manufacturing pipes and films. It has two manufacturing locations in Daman. Co. has also started Lithium ion battery packs business from FY21 [1] [2]
